description: Plan a month of social posts: schedule content per day, save and export.

faqs.a: Pick a month, click any day to add a post (platform + text), and it saves automatically to this browser.
Yes — each post stores its platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn) shown as a badge on the day.
faqs.q: Can I set the platform per post?

faqs.a: Click Export Text to download the whole month as a readable schedule.
faqs.q: How do I export the calendar?

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage, keyed by month.

howto: Pick a month with the month picker.
Click a day to add a post (platform + text).
Click a scheduled post to edit or delete it.
Export the month as text when ready.
title: Content Calendar Maker
